name: Improvised Healer (Abbey of the Golden Sparrow)
body:
When someone at the abbey was sick, you were routinely called upon to administer aid. Despite having little supplies with which to heal someone, you helped their recovery.

Benefit: Heal is a class skill for you and you receive a +1 trait bonus to Heal checks even if you do not have a healer’s kit or similar provisions.
